name: Sakura Kaomoji Mega Library — Expanded Social Expressions
description: Expanded searchable kaomoji library with multi-tag support, cute animals, emotions, greetings, everyday messages, encouragement, gratitude, apologies, time-of-day greetings, celebrations, travel phrases, and social reactions.

sources.name: Kaomojis.jp
sources.note: Category taxonomy and public examples reviewed, including Cute, Animal, Rabbit, search/mood categories.

sources.name: EmojiDB
sources.note: Public Happy, Cute, Animal, and Cute Animal kaomoji result pages reviewed.

notes: Each record keeps one primary category for backward compatibility.
Each record now also includes a multi-value tags array for cross-category search/filtering.
A kaomoji can belong to multiple concepts, e.g. Happy + Cute or Cat + Animal + Cute.
1,000 additional message-oriented kaomoji were added for greetings and everyday expressions.
Exact kaomoji strings are deduplicated across the final library.
The expanded message set is curated/generated rather than copied wholesale from source pages.
